messages.content: Gabriel and Luri each own a portable media player that can store up to 100 songs. Gabriel has 20 songs on his player while Luri has 3 times as many songs. How many fewer songs can Luri add to his player than Gabriel can add to his?

content.text:
# Solution

**Find how many songs Luri has:**
Luri has 3 times as many songs as Gabriel.
$$3 \times 20 = 60 \text{ songs}$$

**Find how many songs each can add:**
Each player can store up to 100 songs.

Songs Gabriel can add:
$$100 - 20 = 80 \text{ songs}$$

Songs Luri can add:
$$100 - 60 = 40 \text{ songs}$$

**Find the difference:**
$$80 - 40 = 40$$

**Luri can add 40 fewer songs than Gabriel.**
